text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tokai Stakes. Shinko Windy 
dialed in her concentration with her 
"Darkness Switch."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Channel all desire to win straight ahead. 
Don't mind the other girls, nor the 
stands. Run looking only at the finish 
line. Repeating that to herself, she heads 
into the race.
